jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description Computer Engineering (CENG) and Computer Science (CSCI) are four-year programmes offered by The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), which is the first computer science department in Hong Kong that started to launch its undergraduate major programme in 1978. While both CENG and CSCI are rigorously founded on problem solving by programming, data structure, and algorithm design, CENG distinguishes itself from others by offering specialized training for students in areas such as mobile embedded systems, microprocessors, VLSI design, hardware-aided security, and super-computing. On the other hand, CSCI focuses more on software innovation and offers diverse specialized areas such as artificial intelligence, bioinformatics, big data analytics, cloud computing, computer and network security, database and information systems, graphics and computer vision, and machine learning. Students will first be admitted to the CSE department through the department-based Computer Science and Engineering programme. After the first year of study, eligible students will be invited to declare their major in CENG or CSCI. Students with outstanding HKDSE results and good academic performance in the first year of study are guaranteed their first choice of major.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Computer Science and Engineering Starting in 2022, students who are interested in pursuing the Computer Engineering (CENG) or Computer Science (CSCI) programme can be directly admitted to the Department of Computer Science and Engineering through the Computer Science and Engineering (BCSEN) programme, a “department-based” admission arrangement. Upon completing their first year of study, BCSEN students will then declare their major in CENG or CSCI. Students with outstanding HKDSE results and good academic performance in their first year of study are guaranteed their first choice of major. While both CENG and CSCI are rigorously founded on problem solving by programming, data structure and algorithm design, CENG distinguishes itself from other programmes by offering specialized training for students in areas such as mobile embedded systems, microprocessors, VLSI design, hardware-aided security, and supercomputing. CSCI, in contrast, focuses more on software innovation and aims to train students with a flexible curriculum that covers diverse and specialized areas. (1) The Comeback of Computers – The CENG Programme The CENG programme was formally established when the Faculty of Engineering was inaugurated in 1991, with an emphasis on both computer hardware and software. It is accredited by the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE). The CENGN curriculum comprises courses in the following areas: Applications: mobile embedded devices, computer graphics and multimedia processing Computer hardware: circuitry theory, logic system design, computer architecture and interfacing, and computer arithmetic Computer software: programming, data structure, operating systems, algorithms and software engineering Very large-scale integrated (VLSI) circuit design: Computer-aided design and applications System connectivity: computer networks, etc. (2) Gearing Up for Technological and Digitized Society – The CSCI Programme The CSCI programme, launched more than 40 years ago, was the first computer science programme in Hong Kong. It is accredited by the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE) and has gained an international reputation for excellence in research and teaching. The CSCIN programme covers the following areas: Artificial Intelligence Big Data Analytics Bioinformatics Computer and Network Security Computer Systems and Networking Computer-aided Design Databases Digital Hardware Technologies Information Systems Internet Multimedia Technology Programming Languages Software Engineering Theoretical Computer Science

Quite a number of our graduates have started their own businesses and become successful entrepreneurs. admission.title: Admission Requirements
content: To be considered for JS4412 Computer Science and Engineering, you must meet the following minimum requirements:
Core Subjects: Chinese Language Level 3, English Language Level 3, Mathematics Compulsory Part Level 4, Citizenship and Social Development Attained.
Elective Subjects: At least one of Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Information and Communication Technology, or Mathematics Extended Module 1 or 2 at Level 3; plus one other elective at Level 3.
First Year Intake: 113
Duration: 4 years
Tuition: HK$47,000 (local students)
Interview: Yes (selected applicants)
2025 JUPAS Application Statistics: Band A applications 343, offers 117, total applications 1700.
2025 JUPAS Admission Scores (Best 5):
Median: 42.875
Lower quartile (LQ): 40.375
Upper quartile (UQ): 44.5
Median Admit Subject Profile:
Chinese: 3, English: 4, Mathematics: 5*, CSD: A, M1/M2: 5, 1st Elective: 5*, 2nd Elective: 5
Subject Weighting: Mathematics (x1.5), M1/M2 (x1.75), Biology/Chemistry/Physics/DAT/ICT (x1.5).

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: The Computer Science and Engineering programme is a department-based admission scheme that allows students to enter the Department of Computer Science and Engineering directly. After the first year, students declare their major in either Computer Engineering (CENG) or Computer Science (CSCI).

CENG focuses on hardware-software integration, covering mobile embedded systems, microprocessors, VLSI design, hardware-aided security, and supercomputing. CSCI emphasizes software innovation, with specializations in artificial intelligence, big data analytics, bioinformatics, cloud computing, computer and network security, databases, graphics and computer vision, and machine learning.
Both streams are founded on problem solving by programming, data structures, and algorithm design. The curriculum is accredited by the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers (HKIE).
Students with outstanding HKDSE results and good first-year academic performance are guaranteed their first choice of major.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: Graduates of the Computer Science and Engineering programme have a strong alumni network in Hong Kong, the US, and Mainland China. Many hold key positions in the HKSAR government, HSBC, Intel, Microsoft, IBM, and Google.

A number of alumni have become successful entrepreneurs, founding their own companies. Others pursue postgraduate studies and take up teaching and research roles at prestigious institutions locally and overseas.
The programme's HKIE accreditation further enhances professional recognition and career mobility.

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK's Shatin campus offers a vibrant learning environment with nine colleges, each providing unique residential, cultural, and pastoral support.

Students benefit from state-of-the-art facilities, including computer labs, libraries, and research centres. The Department of Computer Science and Engineering organizes seminars, hackathons, and industry networking events.
Exchange and internship opportunities are available through the university's global partnerships, though specific details are not listed in the official programme page.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: In 2025, JS4412 received 1,700 total applications, with 343 in Band A. 117 offers were made to Band A applicants, yielding a Band A offer rate of approximately 34.1%.
The Band A applications per offer ratio is about 2.9, indicating strong competition.
Median admission score (Best 5) was 42.875, with LQ 40.375 and UQ 44.5. Achieving scores above the median significantly improves chances.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni
content: The programme has produced distinguished academics and industry leaders:
Irwin King (金國慶) – Professor at CUHK, known for machine learning and social computing research.
Michael R. Lyu (呂榮聰) – Professor at CUHK, renowned for software reliability and fault-tolerant computing.
John C.S. Lui (雷兆輝) – Professor at CUHK, expert in computer networks and performance evaluation.
Wong Kam-fai (黃錦輝) – Professor at CUHK, specialist in natural language processing and web mining.
James She (佘日峰) – Professor at HKUST, known for mobile computing and IoT; PhD from CUHK CSE.
Faculty include IEEE Fellows and ACM Distinguished Scientists, with awards such as the ACM SIGMOD Test of Time Award.

scholarships.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships for local and non-local students based on academic merit. These may cover tuition fees and living expenses.

JUPAS students are automatically considered for admission scholarships. Additional financial aid schemes include the Tertiary Student Finance Scheme (TSFS) and the Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLSPS).
For details, visit: https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS4412 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score Above Median**
- Aim for a Best 5 score of at least 43, with Mathematics at 5* or above and M1/M2 at 5 or above.
- Use the subject weighting: Mathematics (x1.5), M1/M2 (x1.75), and science/ICT (x1.5) to maximize your score.
**2. Prioritize Mathematics and M1/M2**
- Mathematics Compulsory Part requires Level 4 minimum, but Level 5* or above is typical for admitted students.
- M1 or M2 is heavily weighted (x1.75); aim for Level 5 or above.
**3. Excel in English and Electives**
- English Level 4 is the median; Level 5 or above strengthens your profile.
- Choose electives from Biology, Chemistry, Physics, ICT, or DAT to benefit from the x1.5 weighting.
**4. Prepare for the Interview**
- The programme requires an interview for selected applicants. Demonstrate passion for computing, problem-solving skills, and awareness of current tech trends.
- Practice explaining your projects or coding experience.
**5. Apply in Band A**
- All 117 offers in 2025 went to Band A applicants. Band A placement is critical.
- Use Band A to signal strong interest and maximize chances.
**6. Leverage CSD Attained**
- Citizenship and Social Development only requires 'Attained' (or Level 2 in Liberal Studies). It does not affect score calculation.
**7. Consider Applied Learning Courses**
- The programme accepts specific Applied Learning courses with 'Attained with Distinction I/II' as an extra elective for bonus points.
**8. Research the Majors**
- Understand the difference between CENG (hardware-focused) and CSCI (software-focused). Your choice after Year 1 should align with your interests and career goals.
**9. Visit the Programme Website**
- Check https://www.cse.cuhk.edu.hk/admission/cscin/ for updates on curriculum, events, and application tips.

admission.title: 入學要求
content: 申請JS4412計算機科學與工程須符合以下最低要求：
核心科目：中國語文第3級，英國語文第3級，數學必修部分第4級，公民與社會發展科達標。
選修科目：至少一科生物、物理、化學、資訊及通訊科技或數學延伸部分單元一或二達第3級；另加一科選修達第3級。
首年學額：113
修讀年期：4年
首年學費：HK$47,000（本地學生）
面試：有（選定申請人）
2025年聯招申請統計：Band A申請343人，取錄117人，總申請1700人。
2025年聯招入學分數（最佳五科）：
下四分位數：40.375
上四分位數：44.5
中位數取錄者科目成績：
中國語文：3，英國語文：4，數學：5*，公民科：A，M1/M2：5，第一選修：5*，第二選修：5
科目比重：數學（x1.5），M1/M2（x1.75），生物/化學/物理/設計與應用科技/資訊及通訊科技（x1.5）。

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 計算機科學與工程課程為學系為本收生，學生直接入讀計算機科學與工程學系。第一年後，學生可選擇主修計算機工程（CENG）或計算機科學（CSCI）。
CENG專注硬件與軟件整合，涵蓋流動嵌入式系統、微處理器、超大規模集成電路設計、硬件輔助安全及超級計算。CSCI強調軟件創新，提供人工智能、大數據分析、生物信息學、雲端計算、計算機及網絡安全、數據庫、圖像及計算機視覺、機器學習等專業範疇。
兩個主修均以編程解難、數據結構及算法設計為基礎。課程獲香港工程師學會（HKIE）認可。
文憑試成績優異及第一年學業成績良好的學生，可獲保證首選主修。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生校友網絡遍佈香港、美國及中國內地，不少任職於香港特區政府、滙豐銀行、英特爾、微軟、IBM及Google等機構。
部分校友成功創業，亦有校友繼續深造，於本地及海外知名院校從事教學及研究。
HKIE認證進一步提升專業認受性及職業流動性。

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學沙田校園提供充滿活力的學習環境，設有九所書院，各具獨特的住宿、文化及關顧支援。
學生可使用先進的電腦實驗室、圖書館及研究中心。計算機科學與工程學系舉辦研討會、黑客松及業界交流活動。
大學透過環球合作夥伴提供交流及實習機會，惟官方課程頁面未列具體詳情。

competitiveness.title: 競爭情況
content: 2025年JS4412共收到1700份申請，其中Band A有343份。Band A申請人獲發117個學額，Band A取錄率約34.1%。
Band A申請與學額比例約2.9，競爭激烈。
中位數入學分數（最佳五科）為42.875，下四分位數40.375，上四分位數44.5。分數高於中位數可大幅提升機會。

金國慶（Irwin King）– 香港中文大學教授，專注機器學習及社交計算研究。
呂榮聰（Michael R. Lyu）– 香港中文大學教授，以軟件可靠性及容錯計算聞名。
雷兆輝（John C.S. Lui）– 香港中文大學教授，計算機網絡及性能評估專家。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地及非本地學生提供多項基於學術成績的入學獎學金，可涵蓋學費及生活費。
聯招申請人會自動被考慮入學獎學金。其他資助計劃包括專上學生資助計劃（TSFS）及免入息審查貸款計劃（NLSPS）。
詳情請瀏覽：https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/

tips.title: Ace Sir的JS4412策略 — 9個實用貼士
content: **1. 目標分數高於中位數**
- 最佳五科目標至少43分，數學達5*或以上，M1/M2達5或以上。
- 利用科目比重：數學（x1.5）、M1/M2（x1.75）、科學/ICT（x1.5）以最大化分數。
**2. 優先處理數學及M1/M2**
- 數學必修部分最低要求第4級，但取錄者通常達5*或以上。
- M1或M2比重高（x1.75），目標第5級或以上。
**3. 在英文及選修科表現出色**
- 英文中位數為第4級，第5級或以上可增強競爭力。
- 選擇生物、化學、物理、ICT或設計與應用科技等選修科，以獲得x1.5比重。
**4. 準備面試**
- 課程為選定申請人設有面試。展示對計算的熱誠、解難能力及對科技趨勢的認識。
- 練習介紹你的項目或編程經驗。
**5. 將課程放在Band A**
- 2025年所有學額均給予Band A申請人。Band A位置至關重要。
- 利用Band A表達強烈興趣，最大化機會。
**6. 善用公民科達標**
- 公民與社會發展科只需「達標」（或2023年前的通識教育第2級），不影響分數計算。
**7. 考慮應用學習課程**
- 課程接受特定應用學習課程，取得「達標並表現優異I/II」可作為額外選修科獲加分。
**8. 了解主修選擇**
- 了解CENG（硬件為主）與CSCI（軟件為主）的分別。第一年後的選擇應配合個人興趣及事業目標。
**9. 瀏覽課程網站**
- 到訪 https://www.cse.cuhk.edu.hk/admission/cscin/ 獲取課程、活動及申請貼士的最新資訊。
